name: @brushy/di-bench
description: Benchmarks for @brushy/di-core vs tsyringe, inversify, awilix

scripts.bench: npm run build -w @brushy/di-core && npm run build && node --import reflect-metadata dist/bench.js
scripts.bench:quick: npm run build -w @brushy/di-core && npm run build && BENCH_TIME_MS=1000 BENCH_RUNS=1 node --import reflect-metadata dist/bench.js
scripts.prebench: npm run build -w @brushy/di-core && npm run build
